questions.q: What was the documentary Andrija watched about?
o: That every person has traits of some animal
questions.e: In the video: "svaki čovek ima psihičko ili fizičko svojstvo neke životinje" — every person has a mental or physical trait of some animal.

questions.q: What does Andjelka think she is?
questions.e: In the video: "ja baš osećam da sam ja neki panter" — I really feel that I'm some kind of panther.
In the video: "Ti si, ljubavi, foka." — You, my love, are a seal.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Panter je, bre, *hrabar*, vižljast, brzo trči.
Ide uvek u jednom pravcu, istom brzinom, *smiren*.
Onda njih treba uvek da paziš, da maziš, da se brineš, inače će da *riknu*.

questions.e: After the linking verb biti ("to be") the noun is in the nominative: foka.

questions.q: I majke mi, daćemo ti ___ da jedeš.
questions.e: "We'll give you fish" — the direct object is in the accusative: ribu.
Nemoj da + present tense 2nd pers. sg.: nemoj da se ljutiš — "don't be angry".
